description.value: Berry Good Cafe is a Richmond dessert café proudly operating since 2006, founded by Ivy, a former pastry chef at a Michelin-starred restaurant. The café specializes in freshly baked cakes and pastries made daily from scratch using real butter, fresh cream, and minimal sugar and artificial additives. It also hosts private high tea parties for special occasions, making it a distinctive sweet stop on any Richmond cycling route.

The OSM name 'Berry Good' differs slightly from the website's self-identification as 'Berry Good Cafe' and 'Cake Cafe Berry Good'.
